body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/34152

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1652

## What changed

Reproduced the reported failure on the prepared base: a 10-request multimodal draft-extend with four tokens per request generated only 10 mRoPE position columns for 40 query rows.

The multimodal fallback now starts at the first extended token and creates one consecutive, delta-shifted position per extended token. The existing in-range precomputed prompt slice remains unchanged.

Added a CPU regression covering:

- the reported batched cardinality mismatch;
- ragged extend lengths and different per-request deltas;
- the single-token boundary matching decode semantics;
- the unaffected in-range prompt slice.

Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/34154 is still open and proposes the same core correction; it is not included in the selected base.

## Reproduction and validation

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-dde29a0d6b3d/venv/bin/python test/registered/unit/spec/test_mrope_draft_extend_positions.py -v
pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/model_executor/forward_batch_info.py test/registered/unit/spec/test_mrope_draft_extend_positions.py
```

The regression failed against the old implementation and all four cases pass after the change. On the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), a ragged two-request output tensor exactly matched an independently constructed CPU arithmetic reference.

Raw outputs and the structured result are under `reports/j-dde29a0d6b3d/`.

## Limitations

The Qwen3-VL target and EAGLE3 draft model weights were not available locally. Therefore I did not reproduce the full HTTP serving crash or execute the Qwen3-VL fused/native rotary path end to end. The provided deterministic tiny fixture is Llama-only and cannot validate this architecture, so it was not presented as a substitute. No native code changed or required rebuilding.
title: Fix multimodal mRoPE draft-extend positions
